labels.note: Removing ^ anchor lets invalid-prefixed domain strings pass validation, weakening a security-relevant check.
Breaks explicitly-supported leading-dot domains (e.g. '.example.com'), which now fail validation incorrectly.
Forces first domain label to be >=2 chars, rejecting valid single-char-label domains like 'x.com'.
Removes '*' so single-label hosts (e.g. 'localhost') as domain are wrongly rejected as invalid.
Makes trailing-label suffix mandatory, only breaks rare single-char subdomain labels after the first.
Fixes inner group to exactly 2 chars, breaking validation of common multi-label domains like 'www.example.com'.
